name: EvidenceOS
subtitle: No evidence, no answer
description:
EvidenceOS answers questions about your documents using verified citations only. Every sentence traces back to the source text. If there is no evidence, EvidenceOS refuses to answer instead of guessing.

• Paste or import a document
• Ask any question
• Get cited answers with highlighted source sentences
• Share verified result cards

Health and legal examples are informational demonstrations with cited public sources. Not medical, legal, or financial advice. Always verify citations against the original document.
promotional_text: An AI that refuses to make things up. Every answer is a citation — or no answer at all.
review_notes: EvidenceOS is a document Q&A demo with extractive cited answers. Health examples cite CDC public pages and include in-app and web health disclaimers. No accounts required for core demo. Native iOS features: document import from Files, share, offline error handling, first-launch disclaimer.
